mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 6 months signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns despite a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS over the past 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the unemployment rate below 4.5% strengthens labor market confidence, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative when UNRATE remains below 4.5% but broader market sentiment turns bearish.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in consumer demand (GDPC1) and business supply (INDPRO) above historical averages signal economic expansion, fostering optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative despite both GDPC1 and INDPRO exceeding their respective thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 1.5%), rising interest rates reduce growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive returns when FEDFUNDS > 1.5% in a tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in industrial production demand (HOUST) exceeding 1100 units signals robust economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative despite HOUST exceeding 1100 units in the next 5 days.

mechanism_narrative: An overextended supply side (INDPRO > 107.5) in an expanding economy creates valuation concerns, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive when INDPRO exceeds 107.5 in an expanding economy.

mechanism_narrative: Dual easing signals (FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and UNRATE < 4.5%) create favorable conditions for equity markets, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative despite both FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and UNRATE < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An overextended supply side (INDPRO > 108) in a late-cycle expansion triggers investor caution, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive when INDPRO exceeds 108 in a late-cycle expansion.
